'''Pig tails''' are [[underground]] [[crop]]s that can be [[farming|grown]] only in summer and autumn. They may be [[plant processing|processed]] at a [[farmer's workshop]] to create [[thread|pig tail thread]], which is then used to [[weaving|weave]] [[cloth|pig tail cloth]] at a [[loom]], or [[brewing|brewed]] into [[Alcohol|dwarven ale]], or mashed into [[slurry]] at a [[quern]] or [[millstone]].

Some [[dwarves]] [[Preferences|like]] pig tails for their ''twisting stalks''.
